title: Fix the affine family before extracting a uniform small-scale activity cutoff

statement.quantifiers: For each family Lambda supplied by LA015 with m>=1,a<b and E>0, there EXISTS h0 in(0,1); EVERY 0<h<h0,EVERY p in[a,b]^m and EVERY active lambda at X_h(p).
statement.assertion: ||p-r_lambda||_infinity<E(r_lambda) uniformly in p and all ties. Family and its finite slope set are fixed BEFORE h0 is chosen; no continuity of E is needed.
assumptions: LA015 sequential guarantee, finite family and compact exponent cube.

inputs: One already fixed affine family and tolerance values at its slopes.
outputs: Existential uniform activity cutoff; not a numerically acquired bound.
interface.precision: Strict inequality preserved by contradiction with fixed label subsequence.
costs: Extracting a usable h0 needs effectivity beyond compactness; arbitrary discontinuous E offers no automatic finite algorithm.

proof_mechanism: If uniformity fails, select h_n->0 and bad active labels.
Finite-label subsequence fixes lambda; compact cube gives p limit.
Closed bad inequality has fixed E(r_lambda), contradicting sequential guarantee.
obstructions: Do not choose h-dependent family then reuse this cutoff order.
Formal existence/audit is scoped component, not proof of global permanence.

potential_uses.target: Uniformity upgrades in finite mechanism families
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Check finite fixed witness set and compact domain; do not invoke tolerance continuity when argument only needs fixed witness value.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
